newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - May 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - May 1.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Prosecutors found that President Kim Young-sam's son, Hyun-chul had accepted more than 2 billion won from about 6-7 businesses.
- Two associates of President Kim Young-sam's son were arrested on Thrusday.
- The ruling party and opposition parties are embroiled in a row over demands to ivestigate 1992 presidential election campaign funds.

- Seoul will propose to Pyongyang at Red Cross talks, set for May 3 in Beijing, that rice shipments should be made via the truce village of Panmunjom rather than via the more costly sea route, an official of the Korea National Red Cross said on Wednesday.
